WITH recipients (rid, ord) AS ( VALUES
(CAST(#{rid} AS uuid), CAST(#{i} AS integer))
), removed AS ( DELETE FROM notifications n USING recipients r WHERE n.space_id = #{spaceId} AND n.event_id = #{eventId}
AND n.recipient_participant_id = r.rid AND n.recipient_user_id = r.rid
AND n.kind = #{kind} AND n.target_type = #{draftTargetType} AND n.target_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(#{draftTargetId} AS uuid) AND n.read_at IS NULL RETURNING r.rid, n.count ) INSERT INTO notifications ( id, space_id, event_id, recipient_kind, recipient_participant_id, recipient_user_id, kind, target_type, target_id, title, body, important, count, created_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{recipientKind},
r.rid, NULL, NULL, r.rid,
#{kind}, #{draftTargetType}, CAST(#{draftTargetId} AS uuid), #{title}, #{body}, #{important}, coalesce((SELECT max(rm.count) FROM removed rm WHERE rm.rid = r.rid), 0) + 1, #{at} FROM recipients r ORDER BY r.ord
